translations.web: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.
translations.bsb: The righteous hate falsehood, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.
translations.kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
